# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"a block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / lcc:0.3.2"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It is one of the key components of converting {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} into {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:to_energy"}}.

# Obtaining
This block is not crafted, but is formed by boiling a vanilla {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:cauldron"}} filled with {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:water"}}.

A {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:cauldron"}} can be boiled with the {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} produced by a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator"}} by being directly connected above the generator, or connected by a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:heat_pipe"}} on the side of the {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:cauldron"}}.

# Usage
The steam produced by an active {{"of":"self"}} can be directly converted to energy with a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:turbine"}} placed up to 3 blocks directly above. The conversion rate of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} to {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:to_energy"}} depends on the tier of {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/enclosure"}} the {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:turbine"}} is attached to.

A single {{"of":"self"}} can support between 100°C and 200°C of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:heat"}} inclusive.

Any extra heat beyond this range will be lost (indicated by foam being sprayed out of the {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:cauldron"}}) so multiple {{"of":"self","plural":true}} connected with {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:heat_pipe","plural":true}} are needed to convert the maximum potential energy from a single {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/generator"}}.
